name: Citadel Outlets
description: Only in Los Angeles can you drive to an Assyrian palace to buy blue jeans and leather goods. Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' leading outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants, housed in an architecturally distinctive Assyrian-themed complex. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX and Southern California attractions, this premier outlet center offers shoppers access to major brands like adidas, Coach, Kate Spade, Levi's, lululemon, Marc Jacobs, Michael Kors, The North Face, Tory Burch, Nike, and Vuori.
summary: Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands in a distinctive Assyrian palace-themed setting, conveniently located near downtown LA and major attractions.
